Download ruby artifacts

Download the .gem file of a gem version. rp reads the compact index of the gem
(GET &lt;repo&gt;/info/&lt;gem&gt;), picks the version (--version, default the highest
release, else the highest pre-release, as 'gem install' does), and downloads
&lt;repo&gt;/gems/&lt;gem&gt;-&lt;version&gt;[-&lt;platform&gt;].gem. The compact index publishes the
SHA-256 of the file, and the download is verified against it.

A repository that does not serve the compact index (it answers 404 for
/info/&lt;gem&gt; without saying the gem is unknown) is read through the legacy
index, specs.4.8.gz, instead. That index carries no checksum, so the file is
stored but reported as not verified.

A yanked version is not listed by the index, so rp does not offer it.

```
rp download ruby <gem> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --dir string        Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --force             Replace the file when it already exists
      --platform string   Platform of the gem (ruby, java, x86_64-linux, ...) (default "ruby")
      --repo string       Repository to download from (required)
      --version string    Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
